parameters.prompt: Animate the exact upright white tiger warrior from the supplied image into a steady seamless in-place walking cycle for a 2D game. The massive muscular biped stays facing the same three-quarter left direction throughout. Exactly two independent arms and two legs. Alternate deliberate left and right steps with clear foot lift and planting, restrained opposite arm swing, tiny natural torso bob, and a subtle single tail sway. Both clawed feet remain fully visible. Preserve the tiger face, white fur, dark stripes, long mane, bronze shoulder armor, bracers and layered waist armor without changing shape or adding details. Keep the body centered at exactly the same size, no traveling across the frame. Repeat the same gait smoothly at a constant pace throughout all five seconds, ending in the initial pose. Fixed orthographic camera, no zoom, no rotation, no camera movement. Uniform pure green chroma-key background remains absolutely flat. No shadow, scenery, dust, glow, particles, text, weapon, attack, roar or transformation. Full body including ears, hands, both feet and tail always stays inside the canvas. Do not turn toward the camera.
